decision: Prepare for Human Genetics, Correspondence, subscription route; no submission or paid route selected
fit: A narrow correction relevant to reuse of human genomic datasets; editorial interest is uncertain. Do not enlarge the scientific claim to improve venue fit.

official_sources.supports: Correspondence can address matters beyond the journal's own articles. Prepare editable Word,150–250-word abstract,4–6keywords,author-year references,table caption and declarations. Text supplements use PDF with Online Resource citations. Third-party repository licences are not prescribed. No Correspondence-specific word/table cap identified; Brief Report limits do not automatically apply.
Subscription publication has no APC. Open access is optional and paid. No mandatory page charge identified in inspected guidance; recheck the actual offered terms before any agreement.
Scope includes bioinformatics; suitability of this particular fixed-file correction remains an editorial judgement.
Sections4.2–4.6 cover notices,attribution,derivative-database share-alike and access to the derivative or machine-readable changes/method. Keep database and individual-content rights distinct.
Primary article CC BY4.0 notice has stated exceptions for third-party credit lines. Preserve source attribution; do not claim new permission for excluded material.
HGNC data released under CC0; attribution recommended. Exact archived responses and retrieval metadata retained.
Preprints do not constitute prior journal publication under the publisher policy. Existing repository versions must be disclosed, not denied.

January2026 sample subscription agreement distinguishes nonexclusive Submitted Manuscript sharing from restrictions on Accepted Manuscript licensing. Actual agreement must be reviewed before signing; sample is not final legal clearance.
A future repository deposit can document mixed licences instead of applying default CC BY to everything. No deposit made or authorized.

licensing_resolution: The documented F1000 repository-licence policy mismatch is avoided by this venue's external-repository policy. Preserve ODbL data in a separate external package,primary-source CC BY attribution/third-party exceptions,HGNC CC0 and existing Apache2.0 code terms. Do not offer external data for publisher-exclusive licensing or place future accepted files under inherited repository terms without agreement review.

alternatives.F1000Research: Previously verified fee and repository-licence issue remain preserved in venue-audit.json; no paid route chosen.
alternatives.Nature Communications Matters Arising: No-APC route has weaker fit because the demonstrated error is in a later derivative export, not the original article's assays or conclusions.
alternatives.Cancer Genetics: Letter category previously verified, but current fee/format pages inaccessible. Do not assert no fee or a word limit.

limits: Policy compatibility for preparation is supported; editorial acceptance, final agreement, author declarations and publication clearance are not established. No outreach, submission, posting or public-record correction occurred.
